intro: A business analyst resume that shows problems understood, requirements turned into working systems, and the savings or gains that followed.
tips: Show the problem, your analysis, and the result in one line.
Name the stakeholders and systems you worked across.
List methods and tools: process mapping, SQL, the systems you know.

basics.name: Olivia Martin
basics.label: Business Analyst
basics.summary: Business analyst with six years turning messy processes into clear requirements and working systems, in insurance and logistics. Equally at home in a workshop and in a spreadsheet.

work.name: Southern Cross Insurance
highlights: Mapped the claims process with 30 staff and wrote requirements for its new system; average claim time fell from 12 days to 5.
Built the SQL reporting that finance now uses for monthly claims analysis.
Ran user acceptance testing with 25 claims officers.

work.name: FreightCo
highlights: Gathered requirements for a new warehouse management system across four sites.
Found $400,000 a year in duplicate carrier charges through invoice analysis.
